About Veoneer Safety Systems :
Veoneer exists to Protect Everyone in Every Crash. We design, manufacture, and sell the world's best automotive safety electronics.
Almost every 4th car produced today has Veoneer's automotive safety electronics. Veoneer has delivered more than 1.1 billion electronic control units and crash sensors to car manufacturers globally.
The company is building on a heritage of 70 years of automotive safety development. Veoneer is headquartered in the U.S., and has approximately 2,383 employees in 11 countries.
 What you'll do?
Design, build, and improve engineering tools—including desktop, web, test, and automation applications—for internal use by engineering colleagues to support Veoneer product development and engineering processes.
Always prioritize quality: our tools help ensure the quality of Veoneer products and support engineering decisions. Build reliable, production-quality software that earns engineers’ trust.
Develop and improve test and automation tools, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems for defining and executing tests, with test definitions written in Python.
Build a solid understanding of Veoneer products and product-development workflows. Work closely with Tool Product Owners and engineering teams to define and maintain tool requirements, question and clarify them where appropriate, and translate engineering challenges into practical technical solutions.
Design solutions that balance maintainability, performance, usability, and long-term scalability. Assess feasibility, and develop proofs of concept. Maintain architecture and design documentation as code alongside the implementation so that both colleagues and AI agents can use it to enhance development.
Develop new applications and maintain and improve existing ones, applying SOLID principles and appropriate design patterns, with clear interfaces and reusable components. Identify and address technical debt, and contribute to improvements in software architecture and engineering practices. Take equal responsibility for code quality as an author and as a peer reviewer.
Test your code thoroughly and help improve CI/CD automation pipelines to detect defects early, maximize test coverage, and reduce manual testing effort.
Use AI tools responsibly and effectively to support development, testing, documentation, and analysis. Fully understand and take responsibility for any AI-generated outputs you use, reviewing and validating them before incorporating them into the final product. Contribute to practices that help AI agents work effectively with requirements, architecture, code, and engineering documentation.
Collaborate with colleagues as part of a distributed, engaged Agile team.
Take initiative and work independently to move tasks forward.
 What you'll bring?
In-depth programming experience with C#/.NET, for both WPF desktop applications and web application backends.
Experience with a modern front-end framework; React is preferred.
Good Python skills for automation, testing, and applications.
Experience with Git, working with code reviews integrated in the pull request workflow, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
Automotive knowledge, as well as experience collaborating closely with embedded software engineers, are a plus.
Nice to have: experience with databases, Everything as Code, HIL/test systems, or AI tooling such as LLMs, MCP servers, Agent orchestration.
